contextReview.basis: Direct review: cloudy night stone lanes, bakery/café fronts and pale stucco doorways under warm street lamps; no rain depicted (reflective paving is not rain); humidity not inferred.

approval.evidence: User explicitly approved these five editorials (01 v2, 02, 03, 04 v2, 05 v2) and the full automation (2026-11-02, Claude Code publication). Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: Only the lace edge of the camisole shows inside the cardigan, so its body is a conservative reconstruction. Hidden backs, soles and the opposite shoe/earring are inferred. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

producerVisualReview.findings: All 25 products viewed on all four backgrounds. Full silhouettes, no baked opaque rectangles, no visible edge halos or clipping. Clothing/shoe colors and construction agree with approved editorials; hidden areas conservatively reconstructed as documented. Shoe pairs top-down and aligned. No scene props included.

deck.ko: 크림 니트, 토프 스커트, 짙은 갈색 가방의 부드러운 연결.
deck.en: Cream knit, a taupe skirt and a deep brown bag fall into place.
deck.de: Cremestrick, Tauperock und dunkelbraune Tasche finden zusammen.

intro.ko: 가방에서 작은 종이를 정리하는 순간, 단추와 주름과 스트랩이 하나의 리듬을 만듭니다.
intro.en: While a little slip of paper is put away, buttons, folds and strap form their own rhythm.
intro.de: Beim Verstauen eines kleinen Zettels bilden Knöpfe, Falten und Riemen einen eigenen Rhythmus.

body.ko: 크림 카디건은 가운데를 여며 허리선을 잡고, 안쪽에는 레이스 캐미솔 가장자리를 살짝 남겼습니다. 토프 미디 스커트의 흐르는 선은 검정 슬링백에서 마무리됩니다. 짙은 갈색 가방과 둥근 후프가 밝은 상의에 깊이를 더합니다. 톤은 차분하지만 소재의 표정과 손동작은 충분히 살아 있습니다.
body.en: The cream cardigan closes at the middle to define the waist, leaving a hint of the lace camisole inside. The flowing taupe midi line ends at black slingbacks. A deep brown shoulder bag and rounded hoops give the pale top some depth. The colors stay quiet while texture and movement keep the scene alive.
body.de: Der cremefarbene Cardigan ist in der Mitte geschlossen und formt die Taille; innen bleibt etwas Spitze des Tops sichtbar. Die fließende Linie des taupefarbenen Midirocks endet an schwarzen Slingbacks. Eine dunkelbraune Schultertasche und rundliche Creolen geben dem hellen Oberteil Tiefe. Die Farben bleiben ruhig, während Textur und Bewegung die Szene beleben.

tip.ko: 가방은 옆으로 내려 스커트의 주름을 가리지 않게 하세요.
tip.en: Keep the bag at your side so the skirt folds remain visible.
tip.de: Die Tasche seitlich tragen, damit die Rockfalten sichtbar bleiben.
